questions.question: Kerala Mart purchases products from local suppliers and distributes them to stores across Kerala. Recently, the company has faced demand fluctuations, supplier delays, transportation problems, rising costs, and increasing customer expectations. Different departments are also making decisions independently. Answer the following: a) How can Kerala Mart apply integrated supply chain planning to coordinate its activities? b) Explain how forecasting, sourcing, inventory, and distribution decisions can be synchronized. c) How can cross-functional integration and supply chain responsiveness help Kerala Mart manage its current
questions.solution_html:
• Facilities: The number, location and capacity of factories, warehouses and
  • distribution centres determine where products are manufactured, stored and supplied to
  • customers. Proper facility locations help reduce costs and improve customer service.
  • Qualitative forecasting: It is based on human judgment, experience and expert
  • opinions rather than mainly on numerical data. Example: Forecasting demand for a new
  • product when past sales data are not available.
  • Transportation management: Selecting suitable transport modes and planning efficient
  • delivery routes helps reduce transportation costs and delays.
  • Cost: The company should compare freight charges, fuel expenses, handling costs
  • and other related expenses. For example, it can transport bulk raw materials by rail to
  • reduce long-distance transport costs and use trucks for the final delivery to its factory.
